description_en: Retrieves the input and output parameter configurations for a playbook
description_zh: 用于获取剧本的输入参数与输出参数的配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun sophonsoar describe-playbook-input-output --playbook-uuid b724d2b0-3c3b-4223-9bfd-xxxxxxx --lang zh --api-version 2022-07-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePlaybookInputOutput

parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the playbook.

> Call the [DescribePlaybooks](~~DescribePlaybooks~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
剧本的UUID。
>调用[DescribePlaybooks](~~DescribePlaybooks~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: playbook_uuid

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. The default value is **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese

- **en**: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为**zh**。取值：

- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
parameters.name: lang
